subject: Scheduling an Interview for Marketing Specialist Position
body: Dear Ms. Johnson, I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to inform you that we would like to schedule an interview to discuss your application for the Marketing Specialist position at ABC Company. Please let me know your availability for next week so we can coordinate a suitable time. We are excited to learn more about your qualifications and how you can contribute to our team. Looking forward to hearing from you soon. Best regards, [Your Name]
